proposal.description: The soft-start telemetry output is copied from the run-count line and passes on only the run-count width (FCNT_RUN_W bits) of fault_count_ss, so a full 32-cycle soft-start count reads 0 on fault_count_ss_out.
proposal.reason: When all 32 soft-start cycles in the window are faulted (fault_count_ss = 32, which is possible if trip_ss is above 32 or before the trip ends S_SS), fault_count_ss_out reads 0 instead of 32. It keeps reading 0 through S_RUN while the count is held for telemetry. window_trip_SS does not change.

proposal.description: Only the S_RUN count is qualified by the cycle-boundary strobe. The run shift register shifts on every clock in S_RUN, so the window ages by clocks rather than by switching cycles, and the bit the count subtracts as leaving is not a sample that the count added.
proposal.reason: In S_RUN with a switching period longer than 16 clocks, the bit at WINDOW_RUN-1 on a pwm_rise is the blanked comparator value from 16 clocks earlier, not the sample from 16 cycles earlier. fault_count_run and fault_count_run_out then drift from the real number of faulted cycles and can underflow, and window_trip fires or fails to fire because of that wrong count.

proposal.description: Only the soft-start count is qualified by the cycle-boundary strobe. The soft-start shift register shifts on every clock in S_SS, so the 32-bit window holds clocks rather than switching cycles, and the leaving bit fault_count_ss subtracts is not a sample that the count added.
proposal.reason: In S_SS with a switching period longer than 32 clocks and the comparator high for part of a cycle, the bit subtracted at pwm_rise is the blanked comparator value from 32 clocks earlier. fault_count_ss and fault_count_ss_out then drift from the real number of faulted cycles and can underflow, and window_trip_SS fires or fails to fire because of that wrong count.
